title: tune-nccl-collectives-and-scheduling-to-improve-overlap-in-tensor-parallel-runtime
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: tensor-parallel workloads at 4+ GPUs have been limited by serialized CUDA/NCCL execution and scheduling decisions that prevent effective comm/compute overlap during autoregressive generation. This PR tunes NCCL collective usage, introduces per-rank NCCL stream affinity, and improves the runtime scheduler heuristics to increase overlap between NCCL collectives and local compute (KV cache updates and kernel launches). Changeset summary: 1) NCCL: add a configurable nccl stream pool and affinity mapping so collectives use dedicated non-blocking streams while compute kernels run on the primary compute stream; expose knobs for ncclTopoAware and per-collective stream selection. 2) Scheduler: update stream_scheduler to issue a non-blocking collective and immediately enqueue dependent kernels on a follow-on stream with synchronization only when needed; add a lightweight dependency tracker to avoid global synchronizations for small KV cache updates. 3) Kernels: split the KV cache scatter/gather kernels to allow asynchronous host-to-device prefetch and post-collective writes; reduce tail stalls by batching small KV updates. 4) Utilities: add nccl op timeouts and diagnostics counters (nccl_op_latency_hist) for debugging interconnect hot spots. 5) Tests & benches: add a TP microbenchmark and end-to-end integration tests to catch regressions. Implementation notes: conservative defaults preserve existing behavior; new flags are behind a runtime config and default to enabled for Dedicated and Private deployments in our perf builds. Results: internal perfbench on 4xA100 (p2p enabled) shows 12-20% throughput improvement on typical short-sequence chat workloads and 15-25% reduction in 95th percentile per-token latency in TP mode. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] integration bench - [x] docs/release notes - [x] CI green (after one rerun of flaky integration) Related: sees ENG-1459 and ENG-1482 for broader TP roadmap.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Overall change looks good. Please add a timeout for long-running NCCL collectives and guard the diagnostic counters for memory overhead.
Maya Patel: Added nccl op timeout and wrapped counters behind a runtime flag in util/nccl_utils.cpp (see commit a7d5fe1).
Rina Sato: Can we avoid a serialized CUDAEvent wait across ranks? The scheduler change should prefer a CUDAEvent-based local sync only when the dependent work size exceeds a threshold.
Maya Patel: Updated scheduler heuristics to use thresholded local event syncs and added a fallback full barrier for correctness on older drivers (commit c4b9d2a).
Diego Alvarez: Unit tests pass but integration bench was flaky once. Please note the CI rerun in the PR summary.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after verifying perf regressions are negative and unit tests stable.
performance_results: 4xA100 TP (p2p enabled): +18% avg throughput on short-seq chat benchmark (median of 5 runs)
4xA100 TP: 95th percentile per-token latency reduced by 15-25% depending on KV update workload
KV-cache heavy workloads: tail latency improvements of ~12ms at 99th percentile due to reduced cross-rank stalls
Microbench (collective-only): non-blocking collectives reduce blocking time by ~23% compared to previous scheduler
